messages:
Maya: Morning team — quick triage check. Volume ~30% above baseline overnight. Seeing repeated webhook 502s for stripe-webhook-proxy and one macro that stopped expanding. Short updates: what you did / blockers / plan today.

TJ: saw the spike in alerts, investigated. Root cause looks like upstream rate-limits + a proxy retry loop. I paused the retryer on the staging proxy to confirm; errors dropped. Will submit a hotfix to add jitter + cap.

Devon: working on the hotfix CR now — @TJ can you drop logs for the proxy 502s? I want repro steps. blocked slightly by flaky local repro.

TJ: pasted logs in thread: ```ERROR stripe-proxy request failed status=502 id=wh_01Fxyz retry=3 latency=120ms upstream=rate_limited``` Also noticed bursts correlate with one customer sending batched webhook retries.

Sophia: macro issue — noticed /macros/quick_ack stopped substituting {{owner}} after the macro PR last night. I rolled back the macro rule in staging and it worked. I'll open a PR to add a unit test for owner interpolation.

Maya: good catch Sophia. File a ticket and link it here. For prioritization: webhook hotfix > macro unit test. We want webhook fix in prod ASAP, macros can wait for the morning guardrail deploy.

Devon: CR opened: https://git.internal/r/redwood/stripe-proxy/pulls/1543 — PTAL @Maya @TJ. I added jitter and reduced retry cap to 2.

TJ: reviewed, left one small comment about metrics tags. Will approve after that. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: alert created #2471122334-webhook-502-spike, severity=medium, assigned=Maya,Devon

Maya: I'll own the rollout. Plan: merge hotfix, smoke test on canary for 15 mins, then promote. If errors persist, rollback and engage infra.

deploy-bot: deploy started stripe-proxy-hotfix -> canary (deploy id: dpl_3344)

Sophia: opened ticket SR-7892 for macro regression and added repro steps + failing test. Assigning to self for the fix.

Maya: great. Quick asks: if anyone picks up follow-ups, drop a quick note here so I can hand off the incident. Otherwise I'll update the incident channel with timeline.

Devon: will monitor canary metrics and post results in 10.

TJ: pinged customer success to ask about the batched retries source.

Maya: thanks. small aside: reminder to check macros folder for recent untested changes before the next release. :eyes:

Devon: can confirm canary metrics look stable, error rate back to baseline. Promoting to prod in 5.

deploy-bot: deploy stripe-proxy-hotfix -> prod succeeded (dpl_3344)

Maya: prod looks good, closing incident. Thanks all. If anything else crops up, reopen this thread.
